text: Iisaa jaabii ɓe, o torii Alla o maaki : "Joomi amen, Jippinan men kooli- wal ñaametee, men waɗa ñalaande jippagol maggal on juldeere fii mawningol Ma, ɗum wonana men maande e ɓanngannduyee Gootaagu Maa ngun e goongugol kon ko mi Nuliraa. Arsikaa men arsike balloowo min rewugol Ma, ko An Joomi amen, woni moƴƴo Arsikoowo".
